text:
Samira Bose: Noticed a confusing UX loop today: the docs sidecar anchors to section `#deploy` but Console uses an in-page tab `Deploy` with a different scroll offset. Users hit the tab and don't see the intended subsection.

Elliot Park: Ah that explains several support tickets. Are the IDs inconsistent or is it a CSS offset issue?

Samira Bose: Both, unfortunately. Docs anchor uses `#deploy-runtime-flags` and the Console tab anchors to `#deploy`. The sidecar tries to open the docs at the anchor and the page lands correctly but Console's sticky header hides the top ~72px so users miss the header.

Rajiv Menon: Two fixes: 1) make docs expose canonical anchor ids we can target (`data-anchor="deploy-runtime-flags"`) and 2) Console should scroll with a 72px offset when opening external anchor links. We can implement a small scroll shim in the sidecar link handler.

Grace Liu: UX thing: can we also improve the link label? Right now the sidecar says "See details" and opens the anchor. Change to "See runtime flags (docs)" so context flows.

Samira Bose: Agreed. Also suggest adding a landing h1 copy in docs like "Runtime flags" so screen readers announce it when anchored.

Elliot Park: Dev question: does our link resolver allow `#` anchors preserved when routing through the docs CDN/redirector? Sometimes our redirect strips fragments.

Link Bot: link-check: redirector currently strips URL fragments for routes proxied through /help/. Recommend adding fragment-preserve rule in the redirect layer.

Rajiv Menon: I'll add a small patch to the link resolver to keep fragments and add the 72px offset shim in the sidecar JS. Also will add a graceful fallback: if anchor not found, open top of page and show a toast "Section moved or renamed ".

Grace Liu: Accessibility note: when the sidecar opens a docs anchor, we should set focus to the anchored heading (or the first focusable element), and announce via `aria-live` that we navigated to the docs section. This helps keyboard and screen-reader users.

Samira Bose: Good catch. Let's include in the acceptance criteria. Also update the guide copy: sidecar link should include `rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank"` for external docs.

Rajiv Menon: Action items: Rajiv 1 implement fragment-preserve in redirector + scroll offset shim + fallback toast; Grace 1 update link label and aria-live behaviour; Samira 1 add docs PR request to expose `data-anchor` attributes and a short h1 for anchored sections. I'll add unit tests for fragment handling.

Link Bot: Created task #5130: "Preserve URL fragments in redirector; sidecar scroll offset shim; docs anchors & ARIA landing semantics"

Samira Bose: Thanks team 1 small effort but should cut a lot of navigation confusion. I'll follow up with the ticket links in #product.
